primary_function: Modbus RTU data acquisition and industrial equipment connectivity
notes: No official product model number is defined in firmware or hardware docs.
Board designation ESP32-C3 SuperMini is a development-board profile, not a product model SKU.
Device identity for uplink/registration uses the ESP32 efuse MAC (12 lowercase hex); do not invent serial numbers.
Network identity defaults (hostname + Soft-AP) were migrated from icanova-gw / DSE-GW; see network-identity-implementation-notes.md.

This file is the gateway documentation source of truth. Firmware mirrors display strings in src/brand/product_identity.h. Soft-AP compile defaults live in src/config/config.h. The web repo mirrors values in docs/product/product-identity.json.
